label: Create Ecosystem Runtime Resolver
purpose: Resolve runtime versions and only necessary local/stageable paths from the selected project scope. Docker is resolved from Dockerfile/Compose evidence, not a docker executable path.
rules: Use the existing Start/Create project-tree scan as source of truth; do not add a broad second crawler.
Inspect runtime markers only within the bounded two-level project structure, with known wrapper exceptions such as gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties.
Show a runtime control only when the chosen schema/boilerplate or scanned project evidence indicates that ecosystem.
Persist paths only when they are needed and evidence-backed, for example a project-local Python interpreter in .venv/venv.
Expose resolved values to Create config, dependency abstraction, compiler rows and timeline runtime setup.
After Start-tab or Create-tab project read, run bounded version probes for detected ecosystems; stack/category changes alone must not trigger probes.
Prompt Builder operator-flow changes must regenerate the generated operator prompt because the Remember block is part of the exported operator-flow contract.
Stageable runtimes such as Python/Conda, Node/NVM, Gradle wrappers, Flutter SDKs, Java and CMake may expose path overrides; global-only tools do not need stored executable paths.
Docker uses dockerfile_path / Compose file evidence. Do not store or require a docker executable path.
Runtime path Browse controls accept both files and folders; folder selections are resolved to the matching runtime executable or Dockerfile/Compose file when possible.
